name: dev-patterns
description: Patterns for TypeScript full-stack projects (NestJS/Fastify, Supabase/Postgres, Expo/React Native, pnpm monorepo; deploy on Railway/Cloudflare/EAS/GitHub Actions): Clean Architecture, API contracts, auth, migrations, testing, caching, queues, observability, mobile UX, email, a project bootstrap guide, and a post-write TypeScript lint hook. Use together with dev-core.
